examples.source:

examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-stepper" site="Global" id="stepper-order-tracking" variant="default" color="natural" size="small" space="small">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="tracking-step-placed" step="completed" step_number={1} title="Order placed" description="9 March, 14:12" />

examples.label: Publishing workflow with an icon for every stage
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-stepper" site="Global" id="stepper-publishing" variant="default" color="secondary" size="medium" space="medium">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="publish-step-draft" step="completed" icon="hero-pencil-square" title="Draft written" description="Last saved 20 minutes ago" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="publish-step-review" step="current" icon="hero-eye" title="Editorial review" description="Waiting on Sara Ahmadi" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="publish-step-schedule" icon="hero-calendar-days" title="Scheduled" description="Goes out Friday at 09:00" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-stepper-section" site="Global" id="publish-step-live" icon="hero-rocket-launch" title="Live on the site" description="Shared to the newsletter automatically" />
</.component>
